# Amira Saleh

Head barista since 2022. Responsible for coffee quality, the espresso machine and grinders, and training every barista.

## How we work together

Amira dials in the espresso each morning and logs the recipe on the board by the machine. She tells me when beans, milk or the machine are off, and she sends occasional notes on coffee that I file under [[coffee]]. We meet monthly about coffee costs and quality.

## Current threads

- Ran the blind tastings for the [[coffee-roaster-change]] and trained the team on the Ombrel house espresso from November 2025.
- Barista training for new front-of-house staff in the [[front-of-house-training-plan-2026]].
- Asks for a second grinder for decaf; parked until after the second-site decision.

## Notes

- Level 2 food safety; she owns the coffee machine cleaning record on the closing sheet ([[daily-food-safety-checks]]).
- Works Tuesday to Saturday.
